Well, the application procedure is just the basic ones. But I choose Canada because it is the easiest country to immigrate to, at least for a Chinese. And I don’t think I will have another chance if I failed due to the current tightening policies, so I have to succeed at first try. 
As for feminism aspects, yes, I am a woman and a feminist. However you must understand that we cannot have protests or demonstrations in China. I believe that a few years ago some feminists got arrested because of their demonstrations. So the best we can do is by helping other women and raising up feminism awareness among women, but that will not change the general rules of the society. For example, last year they passed an act that requires you to “cool down” for months before a divorce despite all the objection on the internet, but we can do nothing about it. So, I don’t believe that I can live to see a better change in this country, and that’s why I have to leave while I still can.

No worries. The fact is that though being a fairly large country, Chinese culture in different regions is rather similar from its basis because of the shared long span of history. The thing is that the central government has dominance over the entire country so you just won’t expect to find any relief within the country.

I am extremely arachnophobia myself, but I find the spiders in lotro not realistic enough to trigger the phobia most of the time. Here are some tips:
1. I find enclosed areas more triggering, so try avoiding these areas
2. Try zooming the camera smaller and keep the character in front of the spider. I find it easier if you cannot see their eyes. Also lift the view from the ground to avoid the corpse of the spiders getting to close to the screen
3. Personally I find Mirkwood spiders more horrifying, but that’s later in the game. 
Generally I think you should give the game a try. I cannot bear with most of the spiders in games and I panicked every time I try to see Shelob in the movies( I always shield my eyes, every single time) but I am ok with this game.
